name: slots-engine
description: Slots Engine — config-driven multi-game slot platform. Core vertical slice: a player can spin end to end.

scripts.// build: Order is load-bearing, and npm does NOT provide it: `--workspaces` runs alphabetically, which puts apps/ before packages/. Apps resolve packages through their built dist/*.d.ts, so an uncompiled package reads to tsc as a missing module — the classic symptom being a build that fails once and succeeds on a second run against stale output. Packages therefore build first, dependencies before dependents (math-engine needs shared-types and rng), and apps last.
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace apps --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types -w packages/rng --if-present && npm run build --workspace packages --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.// test: The globs are quoted so tsx expands them itself rather than the shell. `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts` looks equivalent but is not: zsh expands it to all 15 test files, bash matches 2 and CI's bash errors outright. A test command whose coverage depends on the developer's shell is worse than one that fails — it silently runs a subset.
